news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹10.86 (vs ₹6.23 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹10.86 (up from ₹6.23 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹2.03b (up 25% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹171.0m (up 74% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 8.4% (up from 6.0% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue.
